purpose: Item 7. These cases were used to design prompts, the schema and the metrics, and to debug extraction. They MUST NOT be presented as blind AI evaluation.
contaminated_because: each was analysed in a previously committed research package, or its protocol-schema block was printed to the terminal while designing this package

cases.source: research/evidence_semantics (gnss family) and three packages before it
cases.what_is_known: fix_type < 3 is the no-3D-fix condition; the adapter pops the retained position and records MissingReason.NO_3D_FIX; the distinction collapses at to_core_samples
-1 is the documented not-measured sentinel; the adapter records it without popping _latest, so 5.00 A is served for 0.5 s
65535 means cell not present and is excluded from the pack sum; there is no rejection path
an all-zero triple is treated as absent by both committed decoders; the adapter records nothing at all

cases.note: This contaminated 14 fields at once and is recorded rather than quietly excluded. All 14 are marked DEVELOPMENT in BENCHMARK_SPLIT.json.
